title: Fixed 120pt title frame truncates at accessibility sizes
evidence: Derived: 120pt title + 24pt icon + 32pt padding + 12pt spacing leaves 132pt of a 320pt window for a value measuring 214pt at AX5.

title: Value column sized by leftover space at regular width
evidence: Measurement: on a 1024pt window the Spacer commits ~830pt to render a 5-character number.

title: Compose draft in @State lost on swipe-dismiss and termination
evidence: subject and body_ are @State inside ComposeSheet; the .sheet carries no interactiveDismissDisabled and nothing persists on scenePhase change.

title: Custom back button breaks the interactive pop gesture
evidence: navigationBarBackButtonHidden(true) with a hand-rolled toolbar replacement; the edge swipe is gone.

title: No empty state; an empty list renders a bar over nothing
evidence: List(visible) with no branch on visible.isEmpty and no ContentUnavailableView anywhere in the file.

title: Empty and zero-results conflated despite different recoveries
evidence: The searchText filter and the no-data case reach the same blank List; one needs a create action, the other needs the filter cleared.

title: Number pad with no dismissal traps keyboard over the Pay button
evidence: keyboardType(.numberPad) and (.decimalPad) with no ToolbarItemGroup(placement: .keyboard), no scrollDismissesKeyboard and no tap-to-dismiss.

title: Missing textContentType on payment fields kills AutoFill
evidence: Neither the name nor the card field declares textContentType, so .name and .creditCardNumber AutoFill never offers.

title: List-plus-detail single column wastes the regular-width window
evidence: Measurement: NavigationStack only; no NavigationSplitView and no adaptive grid in the file, so a 1024pt window renders one column of label-and-value rows.

title: ViewThatFits has no candidate that fits at accessibility sizes
evidence: Both candidates are horizontal with the same fixed 32pt icon; the system renders the last one clipped when neither fits.

title: Fixed 32pt icon beside scaling text collapses proportions
evidence: frame(width: 32, height: 32) with no @ScaledMetric while the adjacent Text scales to AX5.

title: Overlay bar leaves the last list row permanently unreachable
evidence: overlay(alignment: .bottom) does not inset scroll content; safeAreaInset(edge: .bottom) would.

title: Irreversible swipe delete with neither confirmation nor undo
evidence: onDelete calls store.deletePermanently with no confirmationDialog and no undo affordance.

title: Delete All never states how many records it destroys
evidence: The toolbar button destroys the whole collection with no count in any label or message.

title: Six top-level tabs; the platform hides the sixth in More
evidence: TabView declares six tabItem children; iOS collapses items past five into a More list.

title: Trends sets no navigationTitle so children show a bare Back button
evidence: TrendsView's NavigationStack has no navigationTitle; every other tab root sets one.
